changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwicddiagnosis AS SELECT d.id, d.icd_diagnosis_uid, d.icd_code, d.icd_coding, d.category_code, d.icd_short_description, d.icd_full_description, d.is_display FROM public.icd_diagnosis d;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwicddiagnosis TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwicddiagnosis FROM report_user;
